tei:div.tei:p: bod la ja byung tshul/

rgyal po 'di snyung ba'i dus gcig bya yid du 'ong ba gcig gis sngar ma mthong ba'i shing gi yal 'dab nyung shes re pho brang gi rtser khyer byung ba| ci yin brtag pas/ rje'i zhal skyem la phan par byung ba la brten nas| blon 'bangs blo kha nye shos rnams kyis/ phyogs bcur btsal pas sngar bod na med pa'i ja shing rnyed/ de 'thung ba'i snod la/ bod dkar byang skya dar rtse bya ba bzos pa lags/ bzang ngan gyi dbye ba drug te/ bzang shos sham rtse la bya kha na shing khyer gyi ri mo yod/ de 'og lab tse la mtsho nang nya dang bcas pa yod/ de 'og shang rtse la spang ri sha ba dang bcas pa'i ri mo yod/ theg rtse| deb rtse/ rdo rtse gsum ni phal dkar ste/ ri mo med pa'am/ me tog la sogs sna tshogs yod/ ja dang dkar yol gyi sngan ma de nas byung bar byed do/ rgya po 'di'i ring la bod ma yin pa'i 'aljang kla'ajangabluyul la sogs rgyal khams mang po 'og tu bcug mnga' thang che bar byung*/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu ba la 'aljang kla'ajangabluyul du 'das/ spur snyer lcog gru khung khri zhes bya bas byas so/ /'phrul rgyal bang so mang 'arongaklasraung blugayon na yod/ ming ni seng ges brtsigs pa can no skad/ bang so 'di nyid lcags ris bskaur nas yod/ de ni hor gyi mi sdes brtsigs so skad/ der rje dang 'a'achil klamachimasablubaza' btsan la me tog gi sras/ khri lde tsug bstan mes ag tshom du grags pa de/ lcags po 'brug lo pho brang ldan dkar du 'khrungs/ de'i lo gzhug la yab 'das/ srid bzung blon po sba skyes bzang stong btsan dang*/ mchims rgyal gzugs/ skyi sho ting 'gro chu bzang hor mang gsum gi byas/ de yang mes srong btsan gyi lung bstan| zhal chem su bzhag pa de nga yin snyam du dgongs nas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas zhi ba spyan drangs/ theg chen gyi mdo lnga dang*/ de bzhugs pa'i brag dmar mgrin bzang*/

brag dmar ka chu/ lha sa 'khar brag /'phying bu nam ral/ ma sa gong dang*/ lha khang lnga bzhengs/ rgya nag ke shang nas mdo gser 'od dam pa dang*/ mdo las rnam spyad bsgyur/ bi byi rtsan pa shi las/ sman spyad sgyur/ 'di'i ring la pho brang 'phying nga stag rtse nas g.yu rdog chen po gcig snyeda'aklarnyedabludo/ /des btsun mo 'jang bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras shin du mtshar ba gcig btsas pa las/ ljang tsha lha dbon du btags/ de'i khab tu 'os pa bod na med pas/ rgya nag rgya rje wing 'jung bzher kyi sras mo/ kims shing kong jo blang*/ kong jo ma sleb pa la| 'asnyags klaganyagasablukhri bzang 'don gyi bu mo ma blangs pa la ko slong byas nas/ ljang tsha 'asnyegs klaganyagasablukyis bkrongs so/ /ljang tsha lha dbon bang so yab kyi mdun/ zlum por brtsigs nas yod skad do/ /der yab dang kong jo 'dus pa'i sras/ khri srong ldai btsan ni/ mes srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs rting*/ lo brgya dang bdun cu don bzhi song pa'i lcags pho rta lo la bragadamar du sku bltams| yab ni dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa la ya 'brog sbal tshan khar 'das so/ /ag tshom bang so mu ra ri la brtsigs/ gral ni 'phrul gyi rgyal po'i g.yon na yod/ ming ni lha ri gtsug nam bya ba lags/ khri srong lde btsan dgung lo bcu gsum pa la/ yab 'das te/ rgyal srid lo bzhi cu rtsa gsum bzung*/ 'di ni 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul par grags zhing*/ 'dis dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i tshul ni bsam gyi mi khyab pa/ khyad par de'i dgung lo 'ga' zhig gi bar la/ sdig blon ma shang 'khron pa skyes kyis gros ston nas| sngar phan rgyal rgyud sku tshe thung ba la sogs pa rnams chos khrims byas pas lan pa yin/ da bar chad zlog thabs la bod kyi lugs bzhin sus ma byas pa la 'chad pa byed zer nas/ lha shākya mu ne bye dems su bcug pa dang*/ mang yul du skyel ba dang*/

dkon gnyer ha shang rgan po rgya nag la skrod pa dang*/ 'bangs gum pa la dge rtsa mi stong pa la sogs pa'i khrims bu chung bcas/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i bya ba mang po byas 'dug pa thams cad rgyal bu rgyal sar ston 'phral nas bkag ma zhang 'khron pa skyes gson dur du bcugajo bo mang yul nas gdan drangs/ dam chos dar bar byas pa dang*/ bsam yas kyi lha khang bzhengs par 'dod nas/ bod 'bangs rnams shed bcog par bya ba'i phyir/ khyed rnams kyi nga 'dod pa'i las/ na ma bzhi yod pas 'di rnams gang rung gcig byed dam/ lha khang zhig bzhengs gsung pas/ lha khang 'dams nas/ rgyal pos dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig lon nas stag gi lo la rba ye shes dbang po dang*/ wa sa bsal gnang la sogs rnams za hor gyi yul nas/ mkhan po bho dhi sa to spyan 'dren pa la btang ba phebs nas/ bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi 'asmangs klarmangasablubating bas/ bod kyi lha srin rnams phrag dog che bar byung nas/ da was mang po rje dang*/ seng gho lha lung gnyis/ ur rgyan gyi blon po pad+ma 'byung gnas| bal yul yang le gshongs kyi brag phug nas spyan 'dren du btang*/ dam chen gyis bskur nas slob dpon mang yul nas tshur 'byon pa dang mjal/ bsus nas rgyal po yon mchod mjal sar/ slob dpon gyis nga che nga 'asnyen klaganyenablugyi mgur gsung pa/ klu rgyal ma gro la pa la gter bcug lha srin thams cad dam la btags nas lha khang bzhengs pas/ nyin mo las mtshan mo mgyogs par 'tshigs/ zur phud dbu'i mtshal klu yis shing phul/ der rgya gar o 'bastan klatan bluta pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum ri rab kyi tshul du byas/ mkhar sa phy-i nang rim pa bdun du byas/ gling chen po bzhi/ gling phran brgyad/ nyi zla gnyis rnams kyi lha khang thams cad/ mdo rgyud sde snod gsum dang mthun par/ phyis lcags ri zur mangs 'khor bdug dang bcas pa rgyal pos bka' gnang nas bzhengs/

btsun mo dam pa dkar rgyal mtsho me tog sgron gyis/ khams gsum zangs khang gling*| 'gro za byang chub sgron gyis dge rgyas bye ma gling*/ pho yong za rgyal mo btsun gyis/ sbu tshal gser khang gling*/ yum gying sham kong jos/ dam pa'i shing khang rtse dgu bzhengs/ blon po chen po shud po dpal seng dang*/ rgyal tsha lha snang*/stag gru klu gong*/ mchims rdo rje spre chung rnams kyis mchod bstan chen po bzhi bzhengs| de rnams shing phau stag lo spyir zla ra ba'i tshes bdun/ skar ma rgyal la 'gram bting nas/ lo drug la thams cad 'byongs te/ sa mo lug la mkhan po bho dhi sa twa dang*/ blo dpon pad+mas ras gnas mnga' gsol mdzad dus byang chub sems skyed gling gi lha gtsau bo rnam snang nam mkha' la 'phags pa la sogs/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam 'phrul mang du byung bas/ rgyal po thugs rab tu myes zhing*| blon 'bangs thams cad ngo mtshar dad mos chug par gyur te/ dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes par mtshan gsol/ rgyal pos rje'i dga' glu bcu gsum bya ba dang*/ blon po chen po rnams gyi skyid pa'i dpal dgu la sogs pa mi res bkra shis pa'i glu re blang*/ brag dmar mtsho mo'i mgur/ me tog pad sdaung rang 'khrungs lo bcu gsum gyi bar la skyid kyi bro mo che brdungs/ dga' staun rgya chen po byas/ de nas lha khang rnams kyi dkon gnyer byed mkhan dgos pa byung nas/ des 'askyen klarkyenablubyas yon mchod bka' bsgros te sbas gsal snang dang*/ was khri bzher/ pa gor bhe ro tsa na| ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'khon klus dbang po srung ba/ rma a tsar+ya rin chen mchog gtsang legs grub rnams la/ btsun pa byar rung mi rung nyams sad pas/ khyad par 'phags byung bas/ bod kyi btsun pa la snga ba sad mi mi bdun du grags pa byung*/ de rnams la bka' ba dpal rtsegs la sogs/ lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad slob tu bcug

de rnams la cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ zhang ban sde ye shes dhe la sogs/ lo tsā ba stong rtsa brgyad slob tu bcug nas/ mtshan nyid kyi chos dar bar byas shing*/ lug lo la dge 'dun de rnams mkhan po'i chos lugs bzhin yod par smra ba'i sde tshugs/ rgya gar nas dbu ma'i dge slong bcu gnyis gdan drangs nas/ dbu ma bye brag tu smra ba'i sde btsugs/ dam chos dar zhing rgyas par byas la/ lo gcig gi bar la chos mang po sgyur te/ mkhan po'i zhal nas bod du mu stegs mi 'byung gis/ bstan pa 'di la gnyis su gyes nas rtsod par 'gyur te mthar rtsod pa phyogs gcig zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes lung bstan/ der rt-ing mkhan po bho dhi sa twa'i dbu la 'phyib klachibs blupa'i 'phra phog na mya ngan las 'das/ spur bsam yas has po ri'i rtse la mchod rten brtsigs nas bzhugs so/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyir bod yul du mi lo lnga cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs te/ lha klu gdug pa can thams cad dam la btags/ sa gzhi gnas gangs brag mang po gnas chen du byin gyis brlabs/ chos gter nor gter bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas/ gsang sngags la yang lo tsā ba sad mi mi drug bya ba byung te/ gnubs nam mkha' snying po| 'dre rgyal ba blo gros/ ru gong bir+ya rtsa/ gru gu u pe sha dpal glang gi seng ge lang gro dkon mchog seng ge rnams kyi blon po la gsang sngags kyi chos skor ma lus pa zhus cing*/ snam gnang rdo rje bdun 'joms/ ce ku ku ra tsa la sogs pa'i/ lo tsā byas nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud sdai mang po gsungs pa rnams sgyur ro// gzhan yang gnyags sku ma ra dang*/ so zur snub gsum/ mkhan po rdo rje rin chen la sogs/ dkyil 'khor bco brgyad du grags pa'i slaub ma grub thob mang du spel/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad nas/ lho nub 'asnga klarngabluyab gling la gshegs te/ lha sras mu ne btsan pos thog drangs bod kyi blaun 'bangs mang pos mang yul gung thang gi la khar skyel ma byas/

la thog tu pad+ma bka' chems su grags pa'i zhal gdams gsung nas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer la 'phyib klachibs blute/ zangs mdog dpal rigs gzhal yas khang du byon/ da lta srin po'i kha snon mdzad cing*/ 'chi med tshe'i rigs 'dzin 'asnyes klabarnyesablupa'o/ /yang bod kyi dge slong mi lnga/ tshe 'di la sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'tshol du rgya dkar la btang*/ bā+e ro tsa nas chos lon no/ / yang tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i chos 'dod gsung nas/ rgyal po lin+ḍa bho dhe'i mchod gnas/ mkhas pa bī ma la mi tra gdan 'dren pa la/ ka cog gnyis dang*/ rma rin chen mchog btang*/ kha che'i yul du mjal/ bsus nas yon mchod mjal dus rgyal blon rnams la/ slob dpon 'di phyi pa gcig yin pa 'dra snyam pa'i log lta byung ba la/ lha rnam snang dang*/ rgyal po la phyag 'tshal grabs byas pas/ log lta sel dad mos che bar byung cing*/ gdams pa mang du zhus so/ / yang rgya nag ha shang 'dul ba la/ paṇ+ḍi ta ka ma la shi la gdan drangs nas/ rtsod du bcug pas ha shang pham nas/ rgya nag la braus sar lham ya gcig lus pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus phyi mor/ bod du nga'i lta ba 'dzin pa 'ga' re yong ba 'dug zer ro// slob dpon ka ma la shi las sgom rim gsum brtsams nas rgyal po la phul/ gang zag las dag pa rnams ni/ ka ma la shi la'i chos lugs dang*/ lta ba la zhugs pa'o/ /yang sing gha la'i blo dpon dha na shi la sogs/ paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa mang po gdan drangs nas/ rang rang gi yul skad dang mthun pa'i bstan bcos gsung tshad thams cad/ mkhas pa bā+e ro tsa na ka cog zhang gsum la sogs/ rgya bod kyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi rim par sgyur/ mdo rgyud man ngag 'chad nyan sgom sgrub ky-i bstan pa nyi mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing*/ yang ya rab kyi skye bo pho mo brgya bzhi cu rtsa gnyis dus gcig la rab tu byung te/ shar du dga' ldan lha phug lhor stag tshang seng ge phug nub tu brag dmar po thon/

byang du ar+ya pa lo'i phug dang bzhir sgom grwa chen po yang btsugs/ mkhas grub chen po bzhi'i rtse gcig gi sgrub pa mdzad cing bskyangs so/ /yang jo mo 'gro sa byang chub sgron gyi sku tshe'i smad la g.yas ru smad kyi lha khang dang rgyal bu mu tig btsan pos/ shangs su 'tshal gyi lha khang*/ jo mo kar rgyal mtsho me tog sgron gyis/ sku tshe'i smad la dpal chu bo ri'i lha khang bzhengs/ mchims bza' lha mo btsan dang | mkhar chen za mtsho rgyal gnyis kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas/ lha khang phyag rjes med do/ /sba ye shes dbang po la sogs chos blon rnams kyi yang lha khang mang du bzhengs so/ /chos rgyal de'i ring la gso byed sman gyi rig pa yang dar bar mdzad la/ de yang bod du sman spyad sgyur ba'i dus gsum byung ni/ dang po chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la/ gso ba rig pa'i dbu brnyes/ lha sras khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la/ srol bstod/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi ring la sman dar zhing rgyas par mdzad zer la/ chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' gnang*| lo tsā ba bā+e ro tsa nas phyogs thams cad kyi sman pa spyan drangs nas/ rgya gar shan+ti gar pa la sogs kyi bod du sgyur nas/ spyir sman pa la mkhas par grags pa dgu cu rtsa gnyis byung*/ de'i nang nas dar byed kun du grags pa'i sman pa bzhi cu rtsa lnga/ khyad par rgyal po'i blas sman du bskos pa dgu ni/ stod na bi rdzi che rdzi 'ug pa gsum/ bar na mi nyag grang ti g.yu thog gsum smad na mnya' dang 'thab zhi stod dang gsum/ zhes bya ba'i drang srong sprul pa mkhas btsun ldan pa'i sman pa rim par byung ste/ rgyal po'i lung gis/ nga ni kun gyi lha yin la/ /'di dag nga'i rje yin pas/ /kun gyi lha rjer mtshan gsol la// mchod cing bkur bsti'i gnas su bstan/ /gsungs pa'i 'phrin dril bsgrags so| |rje de'i blon po ni/ mgos khri bzang yab lhag

bas rgyal to re/ khri gsum rjes stag sna/ gnyera'abrag klastagablubatsan ldong gzigs la sogs pas/ mdzangs kyi las thabs byas/ zhang rje rgyal gzigs dang*/ stag sgra klu gong gis phyir dgra brtul/ rgya'i bkra shis khri sgo phab pa la sogs kyi lo rgyus phyis rdo ring la yod do/ khri gsum rje stag snas/ rgya dang gru gu ljang gsum gyi mol gdum byas| rgya bod mtshams su bod kyi dpa' bo mi dgu'i 'go byas/ rkye 'dus kyi dmag dpung so kha bsrung ba la bzhag pas/ bka' ma log zer ba'i bod 'brog gi sde mang po chags pas/ mtha' dmag bod du mi 'jug pa sogs/ sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'di ni/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas/ bod la bka' drin shin du che'o/ /'di'i dgung lo lnga cu rtsa drug bzhes pa/ shing mo glang gi lo la zur mkhar du sku bshegs so/ khri srong lde tsan bang so mu ra ri la yod/ /ming ni 'khrul ri rtsug snang bya ba yin/ / bang so phyi rgya can zhes bya bar grags/'di'i rtsa na rdo ring yi ge bris pa gcig kyang yod/ rje de'i tshe yong za dkar rgyal me tog sgron gyi sras bzhi la/ gcen mu khri btsan po sku gzhon nu la gshegs nas bang so med do/ /de 'og mu ne btsan po chu pho stag la brag dmar du 'khrungs/ lo gcig zla dgu rgyal sa bzung/ yab kyi dus mchod la/ tshul 'jug gis zla ba la bsam yas su mdo sde mchod pa dang*/ cho 'phrul zla ba la 'dul ba'i mchod pa btsugs/ bod 'bangs byin po'i dbul phyug theng gsum snyoms kyang*/ rang rang gi sbyin shugs yin par dgongs/ mngon pa'i mchod pa 'dzugs rtsis la sogs/ khrims gnyis dar bar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yod na'ang*/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la dug gi grongs so/ /'khrul chen mu ne btsan po'i bang so ni/ ag tshom bang so'i mdun ngos g.yas na yod/ ming ni lha ri ldem bu bya ba yin/ de'i 'og mu tig btsan pos/ zhang rgya tsha lha snang bsad pas/

de tshang gi g.yo thabs kyi bkrongs so/ /mu tig btsan po'i bang so don mkhar mda' na yod/ ming ni skya rings ldem pa lags so skad/ gcung po khri lde sraung btsan/ shing pho 'brug la brag dmar du 'khrungs/ lo bzhi pa la btsan po 'das nas/ khong la rgyal srid bskos pa'i nyams sad pa'i phyir/ khri steng du bzhugs/ dbu la nor bu'i gtsug rgyan gsol bas/ ljid ma theg par 'ja

ི nga pa yon tsam byung na'ang*/ bkra shis pa'i rtags mang du byung bas/ sad na legs 'jing yon zhes pa'i mtshan chags/ rgyal srid lo sum cu rtsa gnyis bzung*/ blon po sa mang rje ldang ldong dang*/ sgra rgyal mtshon skong gi byas/ paṇ+ḍi ta bā+-i ma la mi tra dang*/ ka ma la shi la| dzña na se na/ bal po hūṃ ka ra rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba 'khon klu'i dbang po srung ba la sogs pa rnams kyi sngar skad sna tshogs kyi sgyur ba'i chos thams cad/ rgya gar bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin pas/ rgya gar gyi skad zhe gcig tu sgyur/ bod skad gsar bcad kyi gtan la phab/ snga so'i yab mes rim pas lha khang mang du bzhengs 'duga'angan giklangs niblu'adzam bu'i gling du che tshad thub pa'i lha khang gcig bzhengs par 'dod pas/ nyi ma tsam dang zla ba tsam dang*/ skar chen gyi tshad tsam bzhengs pas/ sa dmyigs tshol gcig gsungs pa la blon 'bangs byin po'i blo la ma chud de/ chu dang brag gi bkag nas de 'dra shong sa bod yul na ni mi bdog zer ba rim par zhus pas/ 'o na skar ma chung shos kyi tshad rgyang grags yin zer ba de tsam zhig bzhengs so gsungs nas/ skar chung rdo rje dbyings gyi lha khang bzhengs/ rab byung thams cad kyi 'tsho ba sbyar/ lha sa dang bsam yas la sogs su bshad grwa bcu gnyis/ yer pa dang 'ching bu la sogs su sgom grwa bcu gnyis/ btsugs/ stangs 'bul 'bul drug sems phyogs gnyis su byas nas dam chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ lha sa'i khyam phra bzos| dgung lo lnga cu rtsa bzhi pa me mo bya lo la sgrags kyi phur 'das so/ /rgyal chen bang so 'phrul rgyal mdo na yod/ yum gyi chab gang skong pas nang gi mthong*/ ming ni rgyal chen 'phrul rigs lags so skad| de'i 'dun na yi ge yig tshang bris pa'i rdo ring zhig kyang yod do/ /rje de dang 'bro za mang po rje'i sras lnga la/ rtsang ma/ dar ma/ ral pa can/ lhun rje/ lhun grub rnams las/

rtsang ma chos la dga' ches/ dar ma sdig la dga' ches pas rgyal sar ma bskos/ lhun rje lhun grub gnyis gzhon nu la 'das pas bang so med do/ /bar pa ral pa can ni mes khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs nas/ lo bdun cu don drug song pa'i/ me pho khyi lo la 'u shang rdor sku 'khrungs lo bcu gnyis pa'i dus blon po rnams gros byas nas/ rgyal sar bskos srid lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bar la bzung*/ blon po grang kha dpal yon dang*/'gro khri bzung rams shogs| 'dre khri rje stag snang gsum gyi byas/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ su lan bra bo de pra dzña dhe ba/ shin+ting gar pa rnams spyan drangs/ lo tsha ba ben dhe ye shes dhe la sogs pa mang pos dag gter legs par mdzad/ sngar ma bsgyur ba rnams kyang sgyur/ 'u shang rdor dpal dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang rgya phub dgu brtsegs khyung nam mkha' lding ba 'dra ba bzhengs| yab mes kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs par dam bcas nas/ ma 'byong pa rnams gsos/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar lha khang dang*/ sha chu sdong rtsan gyi mtsho dkyil du/ lcags kyi sdong po'i steng du/ sangs rgyas stong gi lha khang dang*/ glang yul du/ ring po gsum par/ ble'u 'phrul gyi spre'i dang 'og tu/ ka brag dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ 'od du byams chen lha khang*/ nyang ro rtsig sna gsar du lha khang khrab sgo can rnams bzhengs/ btsun mo cog ro za bal gyi ngang tshul las/ btsan thang g.yu'i lha khang dang*/ nya za mchog lha mos/ smon 'gro stag mtshal gyi lha khang bzhengs | gcen dar mas 'dre'i lha khang dang*/ de'i gcen mo btsan po 'phan gyi | yar lung du dpag bsam ljaun shing dang*/ phug po che'i lha khang dang*/ mkhas btsun sngags pa dang*/ btsun chen rnams kyi/ brag lha mgon po dang*/ yer pa yang g.yan dang*/ nyang ting 'dzin bzhi'i lha khang dang*/ dran kha dpal yon gyi g.yas mtshal dang*/ dam yul me long thang*/

ka ba dpal rtsegs kyis ka ba yul sna/ tshe spongs stag bzang rab mdos/ stong lung lhag ma/ tshe spongs lha bzang klu dpal gyis/ bo dong bya rgod shong kyi lha khang rnams bzhengs so/ /lar ni 'di yan la bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyi rgya bod du/ gtsug lag khang stong rtsa brgyad bzhengs par 'dod do/ /chos rgyal de ni sngon sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan par byed cing*/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul par grags/ 'phrin las kyi gtso bo dam chos la spyod/ dkon mchog mchod/ tshogs gnyis kyi nor gsog rgyal khrims chos bzhin du skyong*/ rab tu byung ba re re la/ 'bangs mi khyim bdun bdun phul/ mtsho ba sbyar bkur sti dang phud dud bgyis/ bstan pa'i shad dang*/ mnga' thang skyed yab mes kyi ring la chab 'og tu ma phyug pa'i/ shar phyogs rgya nag po dbang du 'dus/ spo lon shan dar dkar gyis yol ba bkrams pa 'dra ba la gtugs/ nub phyogs stag gzig gi so mtshams/ stag sha dung gi sgo mo 'dra ba dang*/ byang phyogs hor gyi so mtshams/ bye ma skangs ring nya dmangs mi rgyab 'dra ba dang*/ lho phyogs mon lta la wa ta'i shel gyi dum bu 'dra ba/ de rnams la gtugs shing 'dzam bu gling gi sum gnyis dbang du 'dus par byed do/ /bod rgyal po'i mnga' thang che shos la byung bar gda'o/ /de'i dus tsa na khyim ni bag gro/ mi ni khong dal/ phyugs ni lo dang zla ba na sdud/ mi nyal nyi ma klong*/ 'bri yan sna med/ rta yan sgrog med/ sgo la khyi med/ rje byams 'bangs gus/ grogs gzhung bzang*/ gnyen sha tsha/ pho ni dpa'/ mo ni mdzangs la chas bzang*/ bod 'bangs byin po bde skyid la longs spyod/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ches dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa na/ sku drin shin du 'phye klacheblu'o/ /'di yan chod la skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu dang*/ shin du skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang lnga zer ro/ /phyed po ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang*/

mas ag tshom gyi sras gzhon nu la 'das nas | rgyal srid skyar ya re bzung ba la zer ro/ /der rting nag po'i phyogs dar tu nye ba dang*/ bod spyi mthun gyi bsod nams 'gribs pas/ rje la btsun mo/ cog ro za bal gyi ngang tshul ma dang*/ mchims za skar rgyal/ sna nam za mang mo khong legs/ nyang za mchog gi lha mo/ tshe spong 'azaklabaza'ablumathor rgyal ma dang lnga yod kyang srid ma zin/ rgyal po'ang ha cang chos la dad ches pas/ sba stag sna la sogs sdig blon rnams kyi ban chen po skums/ lha sras gtsang ma grog mor cugs | btsun mo dam pa dang*/ bran kha dpal yon nyes med la skyon phab/ rgyal po nyid kyang dgung lo so drug pa shing mo bya la/ cog ro leg sgra dang*/ lha gdongs rtsang gi mang gro zhang gi lha khang gi rdo 'askras klaskasablula'artsud klabazhudablupa'i tshe/ ral gri rtsab nas bkrongs so/ khu chen ral pa can gyi bang so ni/ don mkhar mda'i g.yon gyi phyogs na yod/ ming ni khri stengs smangs ri lags so skad/ de'i rtsa na rdo ring yi ge med pa gcig kyang yod/ da de ltar na rgyal po la sras med/ lha khang la mnga' gsol ba med/ rdo ring la yi ge med zer | de yan chad la mu ne btsan po the ba'i/ rgyal sar bzhugs pa bzhi cu rtsa gnyis byung ngo*/ /rje 'bangs skyid pa'i nyi ma 'de ba'i dus yin no/ /gcen po glang dar ma chu mo lug lo ba yin/ so dgu lon pa'i dus na khri ral grongs nas/ khong pa'i rgyal srid bzung*/ lo gnyis rgyal po tshul bzhin bzung*/ chu mo phag gi lo gzhug nas thugs la gdon gsol ba dang*/ blon po rgyal ltau re/ stag sna can la sogs sdig la dga' ba rnams kyi sgyur nas/ sngar nu bo la rgyal srid bskos pa'i snying gnad byas/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snubs/ lo phyed dang bzhir sdig rgyal kho na byas/ lo zhe bzhi pa me pho stag lo'i dus/ yer pa'i lha ri snying po na/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gab nas rtse gcig tu sgrub pa la yod pa/

lha mo nag mos bskul nas/ lha sa'i rdo ring rtsa ru/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje rgyal po bkrongs nas bros so/ /de dus rgyal po na re/ nga yang na sgrol ba lo gsum gyi 'phyis/ yang na lo gsum gyi sngas zer/ sdig rgyal de'i rkyen gyi/ chu mo phag nas me pho rta'i bar lo drug cu rtsa brgyad tsam/ bod du dam chos snub 'dug dar ma'i bang so 'khrul dang rgyal chen bar na yod/ de'i ming ni bang rim 'khor lo can zer ste/ rtsig 'phro la lus so skad/ glang dar ma la smad kyi stengs zer ro| |'di man chad smad sil bur song*/ dar ma grongs rt-ing btsun mo che bas bu chung gcig btsal nas mdang mo rang la skyes pa'i bu yin byas pas/ yum ka brtan du chug zer nas/ yum brtan byung*/ des dbu ru bzung*/ chun mo la lto bor gyi sras gcig yod pa/ mar me'i 'od la bsrung pas 'od srung byung*/ des g.yon ru bzung*/ dbu g.yor 'khrug pa byas/ rgyal rigs gcig la phyogs rigs gnyis su gyes/ blon po khu thog sbrangs shang srid dang*/ rngog pas sum sgra rje yab dang*/ rdog rgyal lto ro gel pa rnams kyi byas/ rgyal blon de rnams bsod nams chung bas/ sa mo glang la khengs log byung*/ me mo bya la bang so rnams bshigarje 'bangs bye/ rgyal khrims zhig chos khrims nyams/ phyi'i so kha shor| bod nang 'khrugs/ glang dar mas bstan pa snubs pa'i 'go tshugs nas| dbus gtsang gi mi drug gam bcu'i mdo smad du rab tu byung nas/ bsam yas su/ bod rgyal tsha la na yab sras kyi spyan sngar sleb pa yan/ lo drug cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar la/ spyir bod dang*/ sgos dbus gtsang ru bzhir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgra mi sgrag pa byung te/ sdom pa 'bogs lan gyi bka' chad/ gtsug lag khang rnams wa khyi'i tshang bcas/ tsher phung skyes/ bshas ra lud khang byas| lder bzo la sprang po'i sba zom bkal/ mi dge ba'i las thabs sna tshogs byung bas/

glang dar ma yab sras ni bod khams rnams la bka' drin shin du chung ngo*| |yum brtan dgung lo sum cu so drug la 'das te/ bang so med do/ /'od srung ni shing lo lug gi lo la pho brang yum bur btsas pa ste/ sum cu rtsa dgu la| yar lung 'phan 'dar 'das so/ /'od srung bang so 'phrul gyi rgyab na yod/ ming ni skye 'u lha bstan lags so skad/ de phyin chad bang so rtsig pa yang nub bo// bstan pa phyis dar gyi byung tshul ni/ glang dar mas bstan pa snubs pa'i tshe| dpal chu bo ri nas 'jad pa gtsang rab bsal dang*/ bod gdong pa g.yo dge 'byung*/ stod lung pa dmar shākya mu ne gsum gyi/ 'dul ba'i po ti drai'u rgyab khal gcig bkal nas/ mnga' ris la braus gar log la phyin/ lo ts+tsha ba med pas 'gro don ma byung ba hor yul bskor nas/ mdo smad an chung rnam rdzong*| dan tig shel gyi lha khang du slebs/ de phyogs rnams sdig rgyal dang thag 'gyang shing*/ snying rus che bas chos kyi rda mtshon tsam yang 'dug pa dang*/ bod rgan mu zu gsal bzang bya ba'i tsha bu/ mu zu rab gsal 'bar bya ba| lo bco lnga pa gcig khongs rnams la dad nas/ gtsang gi mkhan po gsol g.yos blo dpon byas te/ dge tshul zhus pa'i ming*/ dge ba rab gsal du btags so/ /'di'i skabs su lha sar/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sdig rgyal bsad nas bros pa'ang*/ mdo smad du khong rnams 'dzoms pa'i dge ba rab gsal bsnyen rdzogs byed pa la/ sngar gyi mkhan slob dang*/ dmar gyi gsang ston byas/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi rgyal po bsad pas kha skong mi rung zer/ rgya'i ha shang ke wang dang*/ gyi wan bya ba btsal nas/ de rnams kyi drung du bsnyen rdzogs byas/ ming dgongs pa rab gsal du grags zhing*/ des bstan pa'i me ro smad nas bslang zhes zer ro/ /der rting lo lnga nas/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis mkhan po mdzad/ yang gong ye shes g.yung drung dang*/ par min gsal|

'tshal pa rdo rje dbang phyug snub phag shi ta/ jo bo ye shes seng ge cog ro shes rab byang chub rnams/ dge tshul sgrub tu bcug pa/ mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas| bla chen gyi slob ma la snga ba khams kyi zog po mi drug bya bar grags pa byung*| bla chen gyi ka rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba yang de rnams la byas par byed de/ bzhi ni zha theb kyi mu thung dang*/ bla gos kyi mtha' mtshams dang*/ tor bu| ka pa la'i nang rnams sngon por mdzad pa/ bla chen dang po bon po'i rgyud par song bas/ thugs zhen gyi brda mtshon yin zer bar 'dug de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan | bsam yas nas yum brtan gyi rgyal rgyud/ mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras kyi gsan nas/ dbus gtsang gi mi drug mdo smad du chos 'tshol ba la btang ba ni/ dbus nas 'aslus klaklublume shes rab tshul khrims/ 'dre ye shes 'bastonaklayon tanablu/ gtsang nas tshong btsun shes rab seng ge lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang bzhi pos/ bla chen dngos la sdom pa blang*/ rba tsun blo gros dbang phyug dang*/ rag sha tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes 'byung gnas gsum pos/ grum snubs gnyis la sdom pa blang te/ de rnams la rba rag gnyis po gcig tu dril bas/ mi drug zer ro/ /yang dbus pa gsum dang*/ gtsang pa gsum/ gtsang min dbus min gcig dang*/ mi bdun zer ba yang 'dugayang dbus gtsang gi mi bcur byed pa yang yod pa ni/ klu me shes rab tshul khrims/ 'dre ye shes yon tan/ klun she rab 'bar/ rba blo gros dbang phyugar shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ rnams la dbus pa mi lnga dang*/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug tshong btsun shes rab seng ge u pa ti ka ra| 'o brgyad dpun gnyis rnams la/ gtsang pa mi lnga zer ba 'dug pa/ rim pa bzhin/ phyin pas mang du song pa yin nam snyam/ gang ltar yang khong rnams kyi sdom pa blangs chos mang du zhus nas/ yar yong dus bla chen gyi zhal nas/ klu mes btsun pas mkhan po gyis lo ston mthu che bas bstan pa srungs shig

tshong ge blo rno bas ston pa gyis/ 'dre kha bkod mkhas pas gzhi zung*/ thams cad kyi bstan pa dar ba'i khur khur gsungs nas/ brdzangs pa bzhin khong rnams yar slebs nas/ rgyal po dang mjal/ bya dga' dang bkur sti chen po byas nas| thog mar thams cad 'dzoms nas/ myang smad rgyan gong gi lha khang bzhengs/ de rting dbus gtsang gi char/ rang rang so so nas/ 'kha chenaklakhag can zhes pa'ang snangablu byas pa'i gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na/ bstan pa phyi dar la/ a mes bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang*/ slob ma dbus gtsang gis mi rnams/ sbyin bdag mnga' bdag tsha la na yab sras dang bcas pa thog ma sku drin shin du che ba lags/ rgyal po glang dar ma'i sras gnyis la gdung rgyud ji ltar byung na/ gcen yum brtan dang*/ pa tshab bkra shis tshe'i sras/ khri lde mgon snyen/ de'i sras khri lde rig pa mgon dang*/ nyi ma mgon dang*/ gcung de'i sras la/ mnyam 'od dpal 'gon de'i rgyud/ rlung shong 'phan yul mdo khams na mang ngo*/ /gcen po'i sras khri sde so dang*/ rdo rje 'bar lde so'i rgyud/ bug pa can dang*/ thang lha brag pa rnams so/ /rdo rje 'bar ba'i sras khri dbang phyug btsan| de'i sras tsha la na ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras mnga' bdag khri pa yab sras/ 'di gnyis kyi dbus gtsang gi mi rnams mdo smad nas chos 'tshol ba la rim par brdzangs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi sde/ lha khang bzhengs pa| bsam yas chos mkho sgrub pa la sogs/ bod dbus gtsang gi bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i bdag 'askyon klarkyenablurjid khur che bar mdzad do/ khri pa'i sras a tsa ra dang*/ dge slong bla ma bhau dhe ra dza rnams so/ /a rtsa ra'i rgyud 'khrong po ba/

cang rgyab pa/ blags pa lam pa/ gribs snyes thang ba/ khum pa rtsad po la sogs pa'o/ /bla ma la rgyud med dge slong gi spel bzhi pa/ bho dhe ra dza'i rgyud/ lha btsun sngon mo/ snyug rum pa lha 'gring rgang pa la sogs pa byung*/ da lta 'o mtho chab thang rtsad po rnams so/ /de rnams yum brtan gyi rgyud yin no/ khri lde 'od srung dang*/ cog ro za rgyal mo legs kyi sras/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan shing mo bya la yar lung 'phang 'dar 'khrungs/ yab mes kyi mdzad spyod ngan pa bor nas/ myang smad sgral bu'i sman lung la sogs gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs| blon po can rgan a po dang*/ 'gro rtsug sgra lha sdong gi byas| sum cu rtsa gsum pa la/ 'asnyegs klaganyagasablustag rtse bas yar lung shor por bkrongs so/ /'di pa dang yum brtan gyi sras/ khri lde mgon snyan dang*/ tsha bo rig pa mgon gyi ring la/ sa mo glang la khengs log dang*/ bang so bshig pa/ sku mkhar rtse nas 'bebs pa la sogs byung bar byed/ de'i btsun mo tshe spang za dkar rgyal g.yo rur bzhag pa'i sras skyed sde nyi ma mgon/ chun ma dbang za 'phen rgyal/ dbu rur bzhag pa'i sras khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal lo/ /de gnyis kyi srid phal che ba yum brtan tshang gis khyer bas/ sku mched gnyis rim pas mnga' ris stod phyogs la bros ste nyi ma mgon la/ sras dpal gyi mgon dang*/ bkra shis mgon/ lde gtsug mgon rnams byung ba la| stod kyi mgon gsum zer ro/ yab skyid ldai nyi ma mgon gyi sngan ma byon nas| stod lung rnams mnga' 'og tu bsdus pas/ phyi ma la mnga' ris zer cing*/ sras che bas mar yul dang*/ nub ral mnga' byas/ bar pas zhang zhung dang spyi cog gnyis/ snyi gong ru thog gnyis/ pu rangs pa dang ya tshe gnyis/ drug la mnga' byed/ chung bas gar zha dang*/ zang dkar la mnga' byed du bcug de nas mnga' ris skor gsum du grags so/ /bkra shis mgon sku mkhar nyi zangs su bzhugs so/

/sras 'khor re srong nge gnyis/ 'khor re'i sras na ga ra dzā dang*/ dhe ba ra dzā'o/ yab 'khor re'i sku tshe smad la yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas thugs skyo nas/ gong ma'i phyag srol bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar bzhed pa la/ rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po med par rten gyi drung du bslab nos te| mtshan yang lha bla ma ye shes 'od ces bya ba ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa brgyud nas lung bstan pa ltar ro/ /des mtho lding gser gyi lha khang bzhengs/ sras gnyis kyang rab tu byung te/ zhi ba 'od dang byang chub 'od/ yab sras de gnyis kyi ya rab kyi khye'u blo rnau ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rab tu byung nas/ kha cher chos 'tshol ba la btang bas| gzhan bcu dgu tshad pas shi/ mdo sde las lung bstan pa'i g.yas ru gzhung pa/ lhung bzor rin chen bzang po la/ dge slong bya'i gdongs pa can du grags pa de lo chen dang*/ ya 'brog mtsho'i 'gram pa/ ri nang pa legs pa'i shes rab kyi lo chung du gyur pa de gnyis kyi lots+tsha dang chos mkhas pa lobs nas tshur slebs/ lha bla ma la da lta rgya gar shar nub kun na/ jo bo dhi paṃ ka ra shrī dzñā na las lhag pa mi 'dug zhus pas/ cis kyang bden 'drongs pa zhig byed gsungs nas| gtsang stag tshal bas lo tsha ba rgya rtson seng dang nag tsho gnyis/ 'khor mang po dang bcas nas thebs su gtang*/ lha bla ma rang gi kyang rgyal srid gcung la btad nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta spyan 'dren pa'i cha rkyen gyi gser 'tshol ba la/ rgya gar mtha' khob la byon pas mu stegs rgyal pos btson du bzung*/ de blu ba'i rtsis kyi bod 'bangs byin po la/ sras gnyis pos gser bsdus pas/ sku lus dang mnyam pa'i gser 'dus na'ang*/ dbu tsam gcig ma byung ba la rnyed nas lha bla ma mu stegs pas bkrongs/ zhal chems la khyed rnams kyi byed lugs de ka yin te| nga blus kyang nga rgas pas/ sems can la phan mi thogs/ gser rnyed pa rnams kyis jo bo dang*/

paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa rnams gdan drongs/ mtho lding du mchod pa chen po bshoms/ yab mes kyi bzhengs pa'i lha sa dang*/ bsam yas la sogs pa la zhig gsos gyis/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i thabs rtsol gyis shig gsungs nas bzhag 'dug de'i skabs su gcung srong nge'i sras/ lha lhas paṇ+ḍi rmir ting dang*/ 'phra la ring mo spyan drangs nas chos sgyur rtsis la/ lo tsā ba bal por pho log byung nas shi chos sgyur mkhan ni med| sngar shes pa rnams nyams su len mkhan ni yod de/ lo tsā med pas paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis po bod du lo 'ga' yar 'khyams so/ /de'i tshe bal po rme ru rtse bya ba/ bod du yong chos bshad na'ang lo tsā ba med pas/ ma go bar phar log de mtshams lo mang rab kyi bar la lo paṇa gyi 'byon zhud chad do/ /de rting lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi btang ba'i/ rgya brtson seng ge dang*/ nag tshos/ jo bo rje spyan 'draungs nas bal por phebs dus/ rgya brtson seng la mu stegs pa'i ngan sngags byung nas 'das/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bod spyi mthun la rgya rtson seng mi 'chi ba'i bsod nams yang mi 'dug da lo tsā mkhas pa med pas nga phyin kyang bod la phan mi thogs/ phyir log 'gro gsungs pa la/ nag tshos/ lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po la sogs pa yod pas/ zhu ba nan skyed pas/ mtho lda ི nga du yon mchod zhal mjal/ chos mang po sgyur/ mnga' ris dbus gtsang gi sa char lo mang po bzhugs/ bstan rab gnas med pa la rab gnas/ yon bsngo ba med pa la bsngo ba/ gshin dge ba med pa la dge rtsa gtong ba la sogs/ dge ba dkar phyogs 'phel ba'i srol mang po btaud/ dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pas na/ jo bo yon mchod slob dpon de rnams/ bod la bka' drin shin du che'o/ /de'i dngos slob khu rngaug 'brom gsum la sogs/ bka' gdams pa'i rgyud 'dzin sde dgon dar rgyas che bar byung ngo*| |jo bo rje'i gsungs lo chen rin chen bzang po rnams kyis sgyu ba yan gyi|

sngags mtshan nyid thams cad la snga 'gyur zhes grags so/ /jo bo de nyid ni dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum pa/ shing pho rta lo'i zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad la 'asne klasnyebluthang nas dga' ldan du zhi bar gshegs so/ /cung srong nge'i sras/ lha sde dang gnam la 'od chen/ u pa dang gsum byung te/ yab sras de pas kha char gyi lha khang bzhengs paṇ+ḍi ta pu n+ya ེ shrī spyan drangs so/ /lha sde'i sras 'od ldai rgyal srid skyong / lha btsun byang chub 'od dang*/ cung 'od zer go cha gsum mo| |yab sras 'di pas paṇ+ḍi ta shadha ka ra warma/ dharma pha la/ pad+ma kā ra rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi gsung pa lo ts+tsha gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas la sogs kyis sgyur ba man nas/ gsang sngags gsar 'gyur zhes pa'i 'go tshugs/ gcen po 'od ldes/ dzñā na shrī spyan drangs | 'od lde'i sras mnga' bdag tshe lda ེ 'i ring la/ rgya gar na mkhan po zhi ba bzang po/ mkhas pa dzñā na shrī/ 'chi med sa ra hi ta/ paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/ btsun mo can/ paṇ+ḍi ta pu h+ye shrī/ su si dhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti ghidhi/ paṇ+ḍi ta gzhon nu 'bum pa/ gser gyi go cha/ bal po bha lan+ṭa/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī rnams spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi rngog lo ts+tsha ba blo ldan shes rab bzu 'ga' rdor gzhon nu mchog chos bzang*/ khyung po grags bzang*/ gu ru rin chen grags| 'brog mi'i shākya ye shes/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ zangs skar 'phags pa shes rab/ gnya' chung dar ma grags/ cog ro chos mchog mar pa do pa/ lho brag mar pa lots+tsha/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ rma ban chos 'bar/ rwa lo cal lo/ sa lo kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ khro lo byams pa dpal la sogs pa/ rgya bod gyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa mang pos/ sngags mtshan nyid/ bka' bstan bcos dpag tu med pa sgyur/ bstan pa che cher gsal bar mdzad pas/ bka' drin shin tu nas kyang che'o/ khyed par gyis kyang mnga' bdag rtsen lde'i sku tshe'i smad la/

khro lo byams pa'i dpal rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi ta spyan 'dren du btang bas/ kha che'i pan chen shākya shrī zhes pa de nyid/ dgung lo brgya cu rtsa lnga bzhes na'ang*/ yi dam kyi lung bstan byung bas/ me pho rta lo la gdan drongs/ bod yul du lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ sa khro lcal gsum la sogs slob ma mkhas pa mang du spel/ gtsang so ba tshul khrims mdzes dang*/ rdor byang rnam gnyis la sogs pa'i slob ma bskos nas/ bstan pa'i srol btsugs/ bod kyi spyi mchod tshogs pa sde bzhir grags pa'i/ bstan pa'i rgyun chu bo gzhung ltar gsal ba 'di nyid mdzad cing*/ dgu cu rtsa bdun pa la rgya gar la bzhud/ go dgu bzhes pa me yos la chos dbyings su gshegs par gda'o/ /mnga' bdag rtse lde'i sras/ rba sdeng*/ de nas rim pa bzhin/ lde bha lde/ na ga lde pa rnams byon/ 'di yan chod la gu ge spu rangs/ mar yul la sogs pa'i rtsad po rnams chad par 'dod cing*/ dpal 'khor btsan man chad 'di la/ sngon rabs kyi yig tshang dang mi mthun pa 'ga' re snang ngo*/ /na ga lde'i sras btsan phyug ldai ya tsher byon/ de'i sras bkra shis ldai/ de'i sras bkra tshan ldai/ de'i sras grags pa ldes/ gser phye bre bcu bdun la/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhengs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi la mchod rtain bzhengs/ dngul dkar lnga brgya la phag dkar dang lhan skyes bzhengs/ dngul dka ra stong phrag bcu gnyis kyi byams pa bzhengs/ gsungs rab mang po bzhengs so/ /de'i sras a sogs lde rdo rje gdan du chos rgyal mya ngan med kyi phul ba'i grong bzhi cu rtsa gnyis sog po la nyos nas/ rdo rje gdan du phul/ rin dngul gar bcu gnyis re lo re bzhin sog po la 'dab pa byas so/ /de'i sras 'dzi dar dmal dang*/ a nan mal la/ pho 'os kyai rdor lha dgu dngul gar lugs su bzhengs/ nu 'os rdo rje gdan gsos/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ de'i sras ra 'u dmal gyi rgya gar nas rgyal khams mang du blang*/

dngul dkar bzhi cu la sman lha mched brgyad bzhengs/ lha sar jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ de'i sras sga smal yin/ ji dar dmal gyi sras| ar 'ji smal gyis gser gar bcu gcig la sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs/ rgyal sa ma thob gong du sa skyar lha btsun byas/ de'i sras yar tsher skyes pa sri ti smal dang*/ dpal ldan grags pas sa skya'i chos khri chen mo dang*/ lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi steng du gser thog byas so/ /de rnams gcen skyid lde nyi ma mgon gyi rgyud pa yin no/ /gcung po khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras/ dpal lde 'od lde skyid de rnams la smad kyi ldai gsum zer/ yab sras 'di pa mnga' ris gung thang man la chags te/ dpal lde'i rgyud mngon po'i mtshon po la thug pa ni/ khab gung thang pa/ klur rgyal gling pa/ bla lung*/ gtsang skor ba rnams te/ las stod yan chod rnams so/ /gcung skyid ldai mjad rta nag na yod pa rnams so/ /gcig ni rgyud rtsad po rgyal ba 'od la thug pa ste/ gtsang groms pa srang myang stod na yod pa rnams so/ /'od ldai'i rgyud gtsang g.yas ru na yod de/ skyid 'khar rtsad po la thug cing*/ shar 'artsong ge'i klagatsong kha'i blurgyal po gcen mnga' 'od chen la sogs pa/ mdo smad kyi rgyal rgyud rnams kyang yin no| |mnga' bdag khri chung gi ring la/ yar lung du byon te/ de'i rgyud dbus kyi rtsad po 'od srung pa rnams yin pa/ de'i sras 'od skyid 'bar/ de'i sras bdun gyi che ba/ zhang rje tsha khri lde 'bar/ gtsang pa tsha drug khri ldai 'bar la sras drug gi g.yu thog pa'i rgyud rna mo ba phying snga ba/ don 'khar ba/ thang 'khor ba rnams yin no| |bye chung lha sgom gdungs chad/ gung lde 'od 'bar spe skyar gdungs chad/ zla ba'i rgyud stags gshegs pa dang*/ bra sna ba yin no/ khri thog thag ma ru sper gdung chad/ chung pa bzhengs spyan 'bar gyi rgyud/ mon 'khar ba/

zhang mda' ba| dpun bdun thang pa rnams so/ /lha ston dkar mo'i rgyud bye chung pa rnams yin no/ /gtsang pa tsha drug la/ 'od btsan/ lha btsan gung btsan gsum gyi rgyud/ bying pa'i btsad po rnams yin no/ /lhun po'i rgyud bya ra na yod/ da ri'i rgyud khram drug pa dang*/ chu mig gog po ba rnams te/ 'od srung gi rgyud yin no| |bod kyi rgyal rab sa byung tshul 'di la/ yar lung jo bo dang*/ 'bya klabyangabluji ston pa/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje la sogs kyi sgrog pa'i yig tshang rnams nas/ legs par bsdus te/ bsdebs pa yin cing*/ ya tsha'i rgyal rab ni gser thog pa rin rdor la zhib par dris nas bris pa yin zer bar 'dugamado rgyud mkhas mang phal cher bzhed mthun par/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa lnga stong gnas pa la/ /thub dbang sa pho 'brug la 'khrungs pa nas/ /lo grangs chig stong lnga brgya sum cu drug /'das pa'i chu bo khyi la bod rgyal gyis/ /snga ba gnya' khri btsan po rgyal sar byon/ /de nas dgu brgya drug cu rtsa gcig la/ khyi lo mtho ri snyan btsan byon pa nas/ /brgya dang go bdun song ba'i me mo glang*/ /srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs nas gcig brgya dang*/ /don bzhi lcags rta lo la brag dmar du/ khri srong lde btsan 'khrungs rting don drug pa'i/ /me pho khyi la mnga' bdag khri ral 'khrungs/ /so drug lcags bya'i bar la rgyal srid bzung*/ /de yan rgyal rabs bzhi cu zhe gnyis byon/ /de rting chu mo phag nas lcags rta'i bar/ /drug cu rtsa brgyad dar mas bstan pa snubs/ /bod khams dbus gtsang dam chos sgra mi grags| |de nas bstan pa phyi dar me stag lo/ /paṇa chen byon pa yan la nyis brgya dang*/ /dgu cu go bdun me stag de lo nas/ /deng sang shing stag brgyad dkar dbus gnas yan/ /nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad sngar 'das kun/ /dril bas sum stong lnga brgya gya lnga song*/ / ma 'ong bstan pa'i lhag ma chig stong dang*/

/bzhi brgya bco lnga yod pa rtsi ba la/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa lnga brgya the zhes lo/ /'di don go ba'i skyes bu shes ldan kun/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron me gsal dus 'dir/ /rnam grol thar pa'i lam la 'jug pa rigs/ /chos rgyal rgyal rabs 'di bris dge ba yis/ /thub bstan bstan pa'i sgor zhugs 'phags tshogs kyi/ /bstan 'dzin 'dzin ma'i ngos kun khyab gyur nas| |'gro kun kun mkhyen rgyal po myur thob shog/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/bod la ja byungatshul/ -PAGE 134--PAGE 135-
